title: The COVID-19 lockdown is extended until 31 January.
text: The COVID-19 pandemic in Germany has resulted in 38,437,953 confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 174,979 deaths. On 27 January 2020, the first case in Germany was confirmed near Munich, Bavaria.

title: January 2021 Christian Democratic Union of Germany leadership election
text: The January 2021 Christian Democratic Union leadership election took place on 15 January 2021 at the party's 33rd Congress to elect the leader of the Christian Democratic Union of Germany. The election was triggered by the resignation of leader Annegret Kramp-Karrenbauer in February 2020.

title: 2021 Baden-Württemberg state election
text: The 2021 Baden-Württemberg state election was held on 14 March 2021 to elect the 17th Landtag of Baden-Württemberg. The outgoing government was a coalition of Alliance 90/The Greens and the Christian Democratic Union led by Minister-President Winfried Kretschmann.

title: 2021 Rhineland-Palatinate state election
text: The 2021 Rhineland-Palatinate state election was held on 14 March 2021 to elect the 18th Landtag of Rhineland-Palatinate. The outgoing government was a "traffic light coalition" of the Social Democratic Party, Free Democratic Party (FDP), and The Greens led by Minister-President Malu Dreyer.

title: 2021 Hessian local elections
text: Local elections were held in the German state of Hesse on 14 March 2021 to elect district, municipal, and city councils and local boards, as well as mayors in some cities and district administrators in some districts. Indirect elections also took place for the Planning Board of the Frankfurt Rhein-Main Regional Authority and the regional councils of Hesse's three governing districts.

title: 2021 Saxony-Anhalt state election
text: The 2021 Saxony-Anhalt state election was held on 6 June 2021 to elect the 8th Landtag of Saxony-Anhalt. The outgoing government was coalition of the Christian Democratic Union, Social Democratic Party (SPD), and The Greens, led by Minister-President Reiner Haseloff.

title: 2021 Würzburg stabbing
text: On 25 June 2021, a mass stabbing took place at a Woolworth store in Würzburg, Bavaria, Germany. Three women were killed and eight others were injured before the perpetrator, 31-year-old Abdirahman Jibril Ali, was cornered by armed bystanders and arrested by police after being shot in the leg.

title: the 2021 European floods began
text: In July 2021, several European countries were affected by severe floods. Some were catastrophic, causing deaths and widespread damage.

title: 2021 Leverkusen explosion
text: An explosion occurred at Chempark, an industrial park for chemical factories in Leverkusen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, on 27 July 2021, at 09:35 local time, sending a pall of smoke over the city. The city of Leverkusen stated that the explosion, which caused a fire, occurred in storage tanks for solvents.

title: 2021 German federal election
text: A federal election was held in Germany on 26 September 2021 to elect the members of the 20th Bundestag. State elections in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern were also held.

title: 2021 Berlin state election
text: The 2021 Berlin state election, ruled invalid in 2022 and repeated in 2023, was held on 26 September 2021, on the same day as the 2021 German federal election, which also had to be repeated in parts of Berlin due to irregularities. Thus, the 19th Abgeordnetenhaus of Berlin was elected twice.

title: 2021 Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state election
text: The 2021 Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state election was held on 26 September 2021 to elect the 8th Landtag of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. The incumbent government was a coalition of the Social Democratic Party and Christian Democratic Union (CDU) led by Minister President Manuela Schwesig.

title: December 2021 Christian Democratic Union of Germany leadership election
text: The December 2021 Christian Democratic Union leadership election was held in December 2021. The leader of the party was elected indirectly by a party convention, for the first time the CDU held a vote by the membership to decide the candidate which the party's executive board proposed to the party convention.

text: "All I Want for Christmas Is You" is a song by American singer-songwriter Mariah Carey from her fourth studio album and first holiday album, Merry Christmas. She wrote and produced the song with Walter Afanasieff.

title: “Wellerman” by Nathan Evans
text: "Soon May the Wellerman Come", also known as "Wellerman" or "The Wellerman", is a folk song in ballad style first published in New Zealand in the 1970s. The "wellermen" were supply ships owned by the Weller brothers, three merchant traders in the 1800s who were amongst the earliest European settlers of the Otago region of New Zealand.

text: John Lorenz Moser, professionally known as Bonez MC, is a German rapper, singer, songwriter, and record producer. He is one of the leading figures in German hip hop and a prominent member of the 187 Strassenbande collective.

title: “Rosenkrieg” by Loredana and Mozzik

title: “Good 4 U” by Olivia Rodrigo
text: "Good 4 U" is a song by American singer-songwriter Olivia Rodrigo. It was released on May 14, 2021, through Geffen and Interscope Records, as the third single from Rodrigo's debut studio album, Sour (2021).

title: “Beggin'” by Måneskin
text: "Beggin'" is a song by Italian band Måneskin, a cover of the song of the same name originally by the Four Seasons. It was first displayed during the eleventh season of X Factor Italia, where the group was coached by Manuel Agnelli.

title: “Shivers” by Ed Sheeran
text: "Shivers" is a song by English singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran, released through Asylum Records and Atlantic Records on 10 September 2021 as the second single from his fifth studio album, =. title: “Easy on Me” by Adele
